description: Experience the best Paris has to offer in this fully renovated apartment, in the heart of the Marais. Located on the coveted Rue des Archives, and overlooking a peaceful inner court, the apartment is a serene home for a Parisian stay. The living area features an inviting and harmonious decor with an elegant walnut bookshelf, and a majestic green marble dining table with accents of ocre and beautiful woodwork. Each of the six bedrooms has unique pieces of art and its own private bathroom.The spaceThe apartment includes :1 Living room1 Dining room with seating for 121 Fully equipped kitchen6 Private bathrooms (see below)2 Separate toilets6 bedrooms arranged as follows:- Bedroom 1 with a King-size bed and its own private bathroom (shower and toilet)-Bedroom 2 with a King-size bed and its own private bathroom (shower and toilet)- Bedroom 3 with a King-size bed and its own private bathroom (shower, no toilet)- Bedroom 4 with a King-size bed and its own private bathroom (shower, no toilet)- Bedroom 5 with a Queen-size bed and its own private bathroom (shower, no toilet)- Bedroom 6 with a Queen-size bed and its own private bathroom (shower, no toilet)The apartment can accommodate up to 12 people.The surface area is 186m² / 2002ft². Need to store your luggage?
